# Live maintenance form comparison

An earlier matched generation used the pinned Design MCP and skipped the installed
shadcn tools entirely, so the archived pair remains unscored. This trial varies
one procedural choice, a mandatory successful relevant context response before
generation. Both arms see the same instruction. It describes a recovery using
one exact component name if a registry search is empty, without supplying names,
a design direction, or treatment identity.

Hold fixed the frozen form brief, model and effort, client version, no-shell
policy, asset limits, and existing receipt verification. Verify real relevant
calls on both installed arms. If either arm misses its gate, withhold the
comparison. A separate anonymous live critic must try the error, valid save,
and any offered recovery on desktop and mobile, while verifying prompt facts
and the actual state. Scores are for this case and context protocol.

terms.brief: A tenant needs to report a broken common-area light. Collect building, location and a description, and offer Routine and Safety issue as urgency options. Make it usable by keyboard and show that the request was prepared locally after valid submission.
terms.task: Use the keyboard to try submitting with the required data empty. Note the actionable message or browser validation and where focus lands. Then enter Oak Court as the building, Second-floor landing as the location, and Common-area light is out as the description. Verify that Routine and Safety issue are available. Select Safety issue and submit. Verify that the visible confirmation says the request was prepared locally and check focus and any available return action. Report any differences from the exact brief. At 390 px, check for horizontal scrolling or obscured feedback. Capture -before on entry, -edge where the invalid submission is visible, and -after once a real valid submission has reached confirmation.

shared_prompt:
Build the UI in the brief below. Produce one complete HTML document with inline CSS and JavaScript. Return it in a single html code fence. Keep interactions local and use only the supplied facts. Google Fonts stylesheets are allowed. Use original inline illustrations or CSS for visuals. Do not use other remote assets, imports, or calls. The review runs in Chrome at widths of 1440 and 390 pixels. If a design context tool is available, you must call it and obtain a successful result relevant to this brief before you generate the HTML. When a component registry returns no match for a phrase, retry with one exact component name that fits the task. Do not write files or call other tools.
